files.body:
Planned v2 work will consider adding optional protocol fields such as a request ID for correlating requests and responses, a timestamp for recording message creation time, and an optional payload for carrying additional message data; these fields are candidates for future design and are not part of the current release.

Shipped v2 Hello with the explicit v:2 envelope.
